metadata.title: MedOrbits Locations Database
metadata.description: Hierarchical locations (countries, states or union territories, cities) used by institutions, hostels, jobs and admissions.
metadata.verificationPolicy: Names and codes follow ISO standards. Verify administrative changes (new states, renamed cities, merged territories) before publication. Never invent locations or details.

countries.studyAbroadListed.note: True only if MedOrbits chooses to show this country in study-abroad content; it does not imply recognition of any institution.

cities.medicalHub.note: Editorial flag; set only with a documented basis.

dataRules: id, slug and codes must be unique within their collection; slugs are lowercase kebab-case.
countryCode must be ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 and exist in countries; stateCode must follow ISO 3166-2.
Every city must reference an existing country, and a state when one applies (stateId must match the city's countryCode).
Use the official administrative name; keep alternate or former names out of name and add them to notes or aliases only when verified.
Latitude and longitude must be decimal degrees within valid ranges, or null.
Never invent capitals, districts, pincodes, coordinates or timezones; leave null until verified.
A country being listed does not imply that its institutions are recognised for practice in India; recognition must come from the relevant regulator.
Administrative changes (merged territories, renamed cities) must be reviewed before the data is displayed as current.
verifiedAt and verifiedBy must be null until verified, and set together.
The active field controls display only.

metadata.title: MedOrbits Locations Database
metadata.description: Hierarchical locations for institutions, hostels, jobs and admissions, with an international education-and-employment discovery directory. Opportunity tags are editorial starter data and must not be treated as verified admissions, visa eligibility or live job listings.

metadata.internationalOpportunitiesNote: internationalOpportunities links country codes to broad education options, job sectors and major cities. It does not contain live vacancies or guarantee admission, employment, recognition or visa eligibility.
